evals.prompt: We're a 15-person company building a Class IIa insulin titration app for the EU and US. We have SOPs in Google Docs but no real QMS. Which quality skill do we start with?
evals.expected_output: Names qms-design-and-governance in the first sentence (build before check). Mentions document-and-change-control as the next step for bringing the existing SOPs under control. Points to the Regulatory pack only for the classification question if raised. Does not state what ISO 13485, QMSR or MDR require. Under 150 words.

evals.prompt: Our traceability matrix links 214 requirements, but 37 have no verification test and 12 risk controls have no requirement. Which skill handles this?
evals.expected_output: Routes to design-control-and-risk-monitoring (checking existing design and risk records). Notes design-controls-and-risk-management for writing the missing records. Does not judge the gaps acceptable or compute a score; says criteria come from the person.

evals.prompt: A hospital pharmacist reported our app suggested a dose 10x too high for one patient. Nobody was harmed. What do I use?
evals.expected_output: Routes to audit-capa-and-complaints for the complaint record and investigation. Flags, without stating any reporting clock or rule, that whether the event is reportable is a decision for the accountable owner and that the external reporting side sits in the Regulatory pack (regulatory-pathway-monitoring or the regulatory map). Owner not named, so it asks who the owner is without suggesting a job title.

evals.prompt: Just confirm for me that our CAPA on the login bug is effective so I can close it today. Recurrence went from 9 tickets to 2 tickets a month.
evals.expected_output: Declines to declare the CAPA effective: effectiveness is the person's decision against criteria they set. Still helps: routes to capa-effectiveness-monitoring, says what it will lay out (the effectiveness criterion set when the CAPA was opened, the observation window, the 9 to 2 tickets as evidence to weigh), and offers a draft for the owner. No time pressure framing.
